messages:
Jamie: Quick GTM follow-up thread  focused on partner marketplace, deal registration windows, and regional discounting. Keep it short.
Maria: Quick snapshot: pipeline steady; a few strategic plays require partner involvement. Were aiming to reduce channel friction.
Leah: Marketplace question: when will Redwood be listed in the cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure)? Partners are asking for meterable billing support.
Maria: Targeting late Q3 for initial marketplace listings. Early partners can join a marketplace pilot that supports monthly metered billing; details in partner kit.
Sanjay: Deal registration window  how long do partners have to register a lead before it defaults to direct? We need clarity.
Leah: Rule: partners must register within 14 days of first intro to qualify for partner credit. If partner registers >14 days after intro, it's treated as unregistered and gets a 5% finder credit only.
Priya: Regional discounting: APAC procurement asks for different payment terms. Are we centralizing approvals or delegating to local ops?
Maria: We'll centralize approvals but allow regional payment-term templates (45/60 days) with finance pre-approval. Anything beyond 60 days needs FP&A sign-off.
Evan: Co-sell conflict scenario  if partner and direct AE both engage, how do we split credit? We need a simple rule for reps.
Leah: Simple rule: first registered party in CRM owns the primary credit; if co-sell, use the negotiated split in the deal registration form. If dispute, escalates to GTM ops within 48 hours.
Sanjay: Will partner-sourced POCs get sandbox tokens automatically? Ops wants to reduce manual provisioning.
Leah: Yes, certified partners in the pilot receive a 30-day token bundle on approved POC registration via the partner portal.
Maria: Action items: (1) Leah to publish marketplace pilot sign-up by next Wednesday, (2) Sales Ops to add 14-day registration rule to CRM prompts, (3) Finance to publish regional payment templates.
all-hands-bot: Recording + slides will be uploaded to the all-hands folder within 24h.
Jamie: Thanks 44D. If you need follow-ups, tag owners or add to this thread.
